title: Association of the IASLC histologic grading system with aggressive pathologic features in invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The IASLC three-tiered histologic grading system for invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma, which combines the predominant subtype with a ≥ 20% high-grade pattern threshold, remains insufficiently validated in screening-era populations dominated by small nodules. We examined its association with lymph node metastasis and visceral pleural invasion in a large single-center surgical cohort. METHODS: We retrospectively enrolled 7,806 patients who underwent resection of invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma between 2011 and 2025 without neoadjuvant therapy and could be graded per IASLC criteria (grade 1, 3,435; grade 2, 3,875; grade 3, 496). Multivariable logistic regression adjusted for tumor diameter, age, sex, and year of surgery, with trend tests, a grade-by-size interaction test, and prespecified subgroup analyses. RESULTS: Across grades 1-3, lymph node metastasis rates were 0.7%, 4.9%, and 31.0%, and visceral pleural invasion rates were 2.0%, 9.6%, and 33.6% (all P < 0.001); versus grade 1, adjusted ORs for grade 3 were 37.48 (95% CI 22.06-63.70) and 14.10 (95% CI 9.81-20.27). In the ≤ 2 cm subgroup, lymph node metastasis rates were 0.3%, 2.8%, and 19.9%, with a grade 3 adjusted OR of 48.66 (95% CI 21.88-108.25); the discriminatory performance of grade for lymph node metastasis was stronger in tumors ≤ 2 cm (P for interaction = 0.006). A micropapillary component of any proportion remained independently associated with lymph node metastasis after adjustment for grade (OR 1.84, 95% CI 1.33-2.56; ≤2 cm subgroup: OR 1.78, 95% CI 1.06-3.00). CONCLUSIONS: Higher IASLC grade was directly associated with lymph node metastasis and visceral pleural invasion in invasive non-mucinous lung adenocarcinoma, including among ≤ 2 cm nodules; grade 3 identifies a very-high-risk subgroup. Histologic grading may inform surgical strategy and lymph node dissection in small-nodule lung cancer.
authors: Herui Han, Zirui Zhu, Jie Gao, et al.
chinese_conclusion: IASLC分级越高，浸润性非黏液性肺腺癌的淋巴结转移和脏层胸膜侵犯风险越高，包括≤2cm的小结节；3级提示极高危亚组。分级可能有助于小肿瘤的手术策略和淋巴结清扫决策。

title: Local ablative treatment for oligoprogression during immunotherapy in metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: Some patients with metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) receiving anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) progress at a few sites while disease elsewhere stays controlled, a pattern consistent with focal, oligo-acquired immune escape rather than systemic treatment failure. Ablating the escaping focus may eliminate the resistant clone and preserve an otherwise effective immunotherapy line. We performed a PRISMA 2020-compliant, PROSPERO-registered systematic review and meta-analysis of local ablative treatment (LAT) for oligoprogressive or oligo-resistant metastatic NSCLC during active ICI therapy, with continuation of the same immunotherapy line after LAT. MEDLINE, PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to March 8, 2026. From 1270 records, 22 studies were included in the qualitative synthesis. Four studies, one randomized subgroup, and three retrospective cohorts contributed to each primary analysis. LAT-oriented management was associated with improved progression-free survival (PFS; pooled hazard ratio [HR] 0.45, 95% CI 0.33-0.62; 95% prediction interval [PI] 0.28-0.74; I2 = 0%) and overall survival (OS; pooled HR 0.41, 95% CI 0.27-0.63; 95% PI 0.24-0.69; I2 = 0%). PFS and OS estimates were consistent across sensitivity analyses, including the exclusion of the one PFS estimate measured to a second progression. The evidence is predominantly observational and of low certainty, reflecting the current absence of NSCLC-specific randomized trials. On this evidence, LAT, delivered predominantly as stereotactic body radiotherapy, may be considered a continuation-enabling option for carefully selected patients with focal progression on otherwise effective immunotherapy, pending ongoing randomized trials.
authors: Ismaell Massalha, Adham Hijab, Reem Zabit, et al.
chinese_conclusion: 在免疫治疗期间发生寡进展的转移性非小细胞肺癌患者中，局部消融治疗联合继续原免疫治疗可改善无进展生存期和总生存期，证据主要来自观察性研究。
